name: auryn-rust
summary: Rust language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-rust engine extracting modules/structs/enums/traits/functions/methods/fields/variants/params/consts, the trait hierarchy (IMPLEMENTS/EXTENDS), and calls. An optional deep pass resolves calls precisely via rust-analyzer's SCIP index (trait dispatch, generics, cross-module/crate), degrading to the fast pass when unavailable.
